    /api/me/spending/top-up-intents/{id}/confirm

    POST /api/me/spending/top-up-intents/{id}/confirm

    Authentication signed-in session; roles: admin, cfo_viewer, fde, hr_ops, manager, member, operator

    Path parameters

    id requiredstring

    Shape: untyped. This endpoint is used by the massrelay app; its request and response are not documented yet.

    Common errors

    • 401 not signed in

    Every error has the same JSON shape; see Errors and Limits.
